Package aor.proj3t.daos.interfaces

Interface UserDAO

All Superinterfaces:
BasicDAO<User,Long>
All Known Implementing Classes:
UserDAOimpl
public interface UserDAO extends BasicDAO<User,Long>
Data Access Object interface for User entity operations.

This interface extends BasicDAO to provide comprehensive operations for managing user entities within the application. Users represent all individuals in the system including employees, managers, administrators, and other stakeholders.

Key features include:

  • Email-based user lookup for authentication
  • User counting and statistics
  • Management hierarchy operations
  • Advanced filtering using UserFilter
  • Organizational structure support

  • Method Details

    • findByEmail

      Optional<User> findByEmail(String email)
      Finds a user by their email address.

      This method is crucial for authentication processes and user lookup operations. Email addresses serve as unique identifiers for users in the system and are typically used for login credentials and communication.

      Parameters:
      email - The email address to search for. Must not be null or empty.
      Returns:
      An Optional containing the user if found, or Optional.empty() if no user with the email exists

    • countAllUsers

      Long countAllUsers()
      Counts the total number of users in the system.

      This method provides the total count of all users registered in the system. Useful for system analytics, capacity planning, and dashboard displays.

      Returns:
      The total number of users in the system, or 0 if no users exist

    • countUsersWithoutManager

      Long countUsersWithoutManager()
      Counts users who do not have an assigned manager.

      This method identifies users in the organizational hierarchy who are not assigned to any manager. Useful for detecting orphaned users in the management structure and ensuring proper organizational hierarchy.

      Returns:
      The count of users without managers, or 0 if all users have managers

    • getManagers

      List<User> getManagers()
      Retrieves all users who have manager roles.

      This method finds all users who are designated as managers in the system. Essential for organizational hierarchy operations, reporting structures, and management-related functionality.

      Returns:
      A List of users with manager roles, or an empty list if no managers exist

    • getUsersByFilters

      List<User> getUsersByFilters(UserFilter filters)
      Retrieves users based on complex filtering criteria.

      This method provides advanced querying capabilities using a filter object that can specify multiple criteria such as role, department, status, and other user properties. Essential for user search and administrative operations.

      Parameters:
      filters - The filter criteria to apply. Must not be null.
      Returns:
      A List of users matching the filter criteria, or an empty list if no matches are found
      See Also:
      • UserFilter

    • findManagersWithoutUsers

      List<User> findManagersWithoutUsers()
      Finds managers who do not have any subordinate users.
